description: PostgreSQL: terminate the application's idle connections older than IDLE_SECONDS so pools reconnect. The DB user needs pg_signal_backend.
Calls the application's own cache-clear admin endpoint through its Service (reaches ONE pod per call; the application must fan out if every replica must clear).
AWS: move the workload's EBS volume to gp3 with higher IOPS/throughput (online change; AWS allows one modification per volume every 6 hours). Uses IRSA via the service account.
